title: A build's photos are labelled once with what they show; media.look says it, and photos-fit fails a photo of people behind a section or a photo repeated while others are unused
steps: S1: createDemoPhotoLabels over an own photo already labelled, an own photo with none and a place photo with none, the model labelling the second as people.
S2: the same with no vision door, a failing model, no bytes.
S3: media.look with a labeller answering people for the first photo and food (heroWorthy) for the rest; with a labeller that throws.

S4: checkPhotosFit on /offers/ with the selfie photo (people) as a section background and on /blog/ with the flowers photo in two 400 px frames and one 60 px thumb, twelve photos collected; then one photo collected; then a food photo as a background.
expect: S1: the held label is used, the other two are sent once; the place photo is claimed and settled done in wo_media_analysis, the own one written on wo_media.
S2: no label and no throw in each case.
S3: subjects, one-line descriptions and heroWorthy on the tiles; the next names people, event, poster, menu-board, logo as never behind words; the failing labeller gives no subject and no error.
S4: two findings (people behind /offers/, repeat ×2 on /blog/); with one photo collected it passes; the food background passes.
evidence: Local rounds 31–33 (WordPress JA Restaurant): a selfie as a section's background on /offers/, a flowers photo behind the Cookie Club card, one photo on two adjacent posts.
fence: createDemoPhotoLabels (wo_media.labels.vision, wo_media_analysis claim/settle); media.look subject/shows/heroWorthy; sourceSubjects; checkPhotosFit (BACKGROUND_UNFIT, REPEAT_MIN, collected.pictures)

tests: a held label is used as it is; the rest are labelled once and kept where each kind of photo keeps it
no vision door, a failing model or no bytes label nothing and never throw
media.look gives each labelled photo its subject and says where people, posters and logos never go
photos-fit fails a photo of people behind a section and a photo repeated while others are unused
